description: This file defines the DataCell class, which is a GUI component representing a cell in a table for a software related to engine tuning and calibration. It manages data display, user interaction (clicks, highlighting), and visual updates based on the data values and states.

classes.name: DataCell
classes.description: A GUI component class extending JLabel, representing a cell in a data table for engine tuning. It manages displaying data, user interactions, and visual cues based on data state and user actions.
